title: Message envelope (v1)
description: Wraps every message exchanged between the Engine and adapter workers. Unknown properties are allowed so that minor versions can add fields; an unknown major version is rejected.

message_id.description: Unique per message. Consumers deduplicate on it.

schema_version.description: major.minor. This schema accepts major version 1 only.

correlation_id.description: Constant across every message and log line caused by one API request.

causation_id.description: message_id of the message that caused this one, if any.
